name: structural-scanner-oroboros
body: `solution.container.structural-scanner` and its components are implemented-by code that resolves in the branch graph: the `rust.mdfrontend.*` units, the `rust.apg.ingest`/`rust.apg.classify`/`rust.apg.git` boundary, and `rust.build_script_build.*`. Packaging edits (`Formula/*.rb`, `install.sh`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`) are target-less maintainer tasks. The spec and plan are expressed in the installed binary's vocabulary: a tracked `File` node becomes an `implemented-by` target once the installed binary's scan renders it.
